Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for a Korean educational dark-fantasy top-down tower defense game, LEVEL 1 heroes, THREE DISTINCT MONSTERS.
Create ONE sprite sheet, landscape 1536x1024 composition, EXACTLY FOUR EQUALLY SPACED COLUMNS and THREE EQUALLY SPACED ROWS (12 cells). Each row contains the same creature in FOUR consecutive walking animation poses: left foot forward, centered, right foot forward, centered with slight torso bounce. All cell backgrounds are genuinely TRANSPARENT, no opaque or colored backdrop. Consistent identical size and anchor for each row, all sprites centered with at least 12% clear cell padding, no cell overlap, no frames/borders/grid drawn.
Row 1: tiny moss-covered pebble courier with leafy ears and an orange crystal drum.
Row 2: round pebble nesting insect with rocky egg sacs.
Row 3: small sprout-topped stone guardian with broad leaf shoulder plates.
Style: original hand-painted chunky game sprite, top-down three-quarter view, fronts facing lower right, thick outlined silhouettes, iron-gray fractured STONE bodies, luminous crystal accents, cute readable expressive eyes, fantasy dungeon, warm rim lighting. This level 1 has small adorable creatures, completely distinct from basic stone slimes and ordinary rock golems. Level progression should feel clear, readable and heroic. Animation changes feet, wings or appendages without changing anatomy or species between columns. NO words, letters, numbers, labels, logos or watermark. Each row is a completely different species and silhouette.
